GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn going well. got away in Straight # much too good
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. moved up Wide turn joining leaders. got clear late # too strong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced for some distance in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 1 length. 2nd turn. got to front 300 metres. weakened late # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Passing the 900m when the tempo slackened, had to be restrained and shifted out after improving onto the heels of rnr which resulted in other rnr being shifted out three-wide..

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. looking for run turn. got split in Straight . ran on strongly with winner # went well
Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off, limited room turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off, held up passing 200m, clear 100m, kept on well late # has excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up for clear running for some distance near the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 4 Lengths 1200m 3rd 3 Lengths 800m 3rd 3 Lengths home turn 3rd Hooked Out 3 Wide Middle Of Track Straight no run on final 200m # Even ch/poor late
Jumped Fair sat back 6-7l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, held up passing 200 and was never fully clear, need to see again # inconclusive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up from the 200m until after passing the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 6l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 4-5l off, kept on ok but never threatening # even effort
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn under pressure. Held Ground # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 50m was steadied from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down 8th Outside 6 Lengths No Pace On checked off heels @ 600m, remained 8th to Straightening Up kept trying without threatening Need To See Again - # bother vital stage
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: Option to be further forward; settled off-midfield. From a wide barrier was shifted behind rnrs in the early stages. Rdr reported after settling at the rear of the field, the mare was not suited by the slow tempo of the race and consequently over-raced throughout. Near the 700m, when continuing to over-race, had to be steadied from heels. A post-race vet exam did not reveal any abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased to last 12 lengths. well back turn. ran on well in Straight # good from barrier
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the widest barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages of the event. Passing the 800m raced keenly onto heels and shortly after shifted to the outside of that runner to race three-wide with cover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 3 lengths. moved up 3 Wide 600 metres. ran on well with winner # went early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Overraced throughout the early and middle stages of the event. Passing the 200m was brushed.
